name: clean
description: Clean talking-head look: off-white word-by-word captions, compact hook blocks whose lines almost touch, heavy serif or number payoffs, a translucent accent marker on specific key words, hard reframes, no boxes. Colours and fonts come from overlays/src/theme.ts.

captions.note: Add the author's own filler words to drop (for example 'essentially'). swiss_numbers writes 10'000 instead of 10,000.

highlight.note: Translucent accent marker behind specific words only, never whole lines.

music.note: No music bed by default. To add one, set enabled true and file to a track you have the rights to (absolute, or relative to this skill folder).

type.note: Kit constants live in overlays/src/templates/Captions.tsx and overlays/src/theme.ts; recorded here so the preset is readable in 1 place. Small text lines touch, compact.

voice.note: voice_print.py: noise print learned from the longest silence, constant gain, denoiser latency removed; no EQ or compressor. clean false keeps the cut's audio as it is.

scenes.note: Blank screens (Interludes) with clean motion graphics: ring for a percentage, list for a spoken enumeration, flow for steps (flows are chosen in review). Hard cut in and out, tones alternate.
